---
title: "Clustering"
---

Clustering and visualisation with FlowSOM.

## `sw_cluster` {#sw_cluster}

Cluster cells using FlowSOM.

### Usage

```r
sw_cluster(corrected, lineage_markers, xdim = 10, ydim = 10,
           n_metaclusters = 20, seed = 42, ...)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `corrected` | A `data.frame`/`tibble` or matrix of expression values. |
| `lineage_markers` | Character vector of marker columns to use for clustering. |
| `xdim` | SOM grid x-dimension (default: 10). |
| `ydim` | SOM grid y-dimension (default: 10). |
| `n_metaclusters` | Number of metaclusters (default: 20). |
| `seed` | Random seed (default: 42). |
| `...` | Additional arguments passed to `FlowSOM::FlowSOM()`. |

### Details

Converts input data to a `flowFrame`, runs FlowSOM self-organising map
clustering, and applies consensus metaclustering.

### Value

A FlowSOM object containing the trained SOM and metacluster assignments.

---

## `sw_get_cluster_assignments` {#sw_get_cluster_assignments}

Get metacluster assignments.

### Usage

```r
sw_get_cluster_assignments(fsom_result)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `fsom_result` | A FlowSOM result object from `sw_cluster()`. |

### Details

Extracts per-cell metacluster assignments from a FlowSOM result.

### Value

An integer vector of metacluster assignments, one per cell.

---

## `sw_cluster_mfis` {#sw_cluster_mfis}

Compute median fluorescence intensities per metacluster.

### Usage

```r
sw_cluster_mfis(fsom_result)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `fsom_result` | A FlowSOM result object from `sw_cluster()`. |

### Details

Calculates the median expression of each marker within each metacluster.

### Value

A `tibble` with one row per metacluster and one column per marker, plus a
`metacluster` column.

---

## `sw_plot_clusters` {#sw_plot_clusters}

Plot FlowSOM clusters.

### Usage

```r
sw_plot_clusters(fsom_result, plot_file = "FlowSOM_clusters.pdf")
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `fsom_result` | A FlowSOM result object from `sw_cluster()`. |
| `plot_file` | Output file path (default: `"FlowSOM_clusters.pdf"`). |

### Details

Generates FlowSOM summary and star plots and saves them to a file.

### Value

The file path (invisibly).

---

## `sw_map_new_data` {#sw_map_new_data}

Map new data onto a trained FlowSOM.

### Usage

```r
sw_map_new_data(fsom_result, new_ff)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `fsom_result` | A trained FlowSOM result object. |
| `new_ff` | A `flowFrame` with new data to map. |

### Details

Projects new samples onto an existing trained FlowSOM model using
`FlowSOM::NewData()`.

### Value

A FlowSOM object with the new data mapped onto the existing SOM.
